passage.label: O believed when adhan called prayer day Jumuah proceed remembrance Allah leave trade better only knew; when prayer concluded disperse within land seek bounty Allah remember often succeed; but saw transaction diversion rushed left standing; say what with Allah better than diversion transaction Allah best providers

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ تِجَٰرَةً أَوۡ لَهۡوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمٗاۚ قُلۡ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهۡوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَٰرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰزِقِينَ

mainSubject.label: Believers commanded to proceed to Allah's remembrance and leave trade when the Friday call is made, since that is better if they knew; dispersal through the land to seek Allah's bounty permitted after prayer concludes, with frequent remembrance urged for success; rebuke for rushing toward trade or diversion while leaving the Prophet standing, answered by declaring what is with Allah better than either, since He is the best of providers

commandsAndProhibitions.description: When the call is made for prayer on the day of Jumu'ah, proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: When the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often.

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the bounty declaration (4) before the Torah-donkey parable opens (5); P2 ends with the inevitable-death disclosure (8) before the Friday command begins (9); P3 covers the Jumu'ah obligation, post-prayer dispersal and the trade-diversion rebuke (9-11).
